name: Print cost estimator
description: Drop a model and get its print time, filament and real cost: material, power, machine wear, failures, your time and fees, with the price to charge for the margin you want.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A model measured and priced: the faces that need holding up picked out in the view, what the print costs layer by layer, and what it makes at the price charged today.
A sliced file beside a model: its time and weight are the slicer's own, so nothing about it is estimated, and the order total follows the quantity.
Setup, in the dark theme: the printer's cost, bed and print settings, the filament, and the rates a price is built from, kept for each user.
A part taken straight out of the library: search the models and pick the file to measure.
